# K3M Excavation LLC

> K3M Excavation LLC is a family-owned excavation contractor based in Mount Pleasant, Texas, serving Northeast Texas within a 50-mile radius. With over 20 years of experience, K3M provides precision-driven excavation, grading, land clearing, and site development services for residential and commercial projects.

## Company Information

- **Business Name**: K3M Excavation LLC
- **Established**: 2004
- **Location**: Mount Pleasant, Texas
- **Service Area**: 50-mile radius of Mount Pleasant, TX (including Paris, Texarkana, Longview, Tyler, and Sulphur Springs)
- **Phone**: 903-563-4750
- **Email**: k3mllc@hotmail.com
- **Facebook**: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61582033561846

## Core Services

### Land Clearing & Mulching
Reclaim your land with high-flow forestry mulching and professional clearing services. K3M handles brush removal, tree clearing, and lot preparation for residential and commercial projects.

### Site Prep & GPS Grading
Precision grading and pad construction using the latest GPS site technology. Accurate to the inch for foundations, driveways, and commercial pads.

### Driveways & Infrastructure
Durable access roads, driveways, and specialized roadway stabilization. Built to last with proper base preparation and drainage considerations.

### Ponds & Advanced Drainage
Stock ponds, drainage correction, and water management solutions. Includes pond construction, French drains, culvert installation, and erosion control.

### Demolition & Reclamation
Structural removal and site restoration with surgical demolition techniques. Safe, efficient demolition of residential and commercial structures with debris removal.

### Underground Utilities
Utility trenching, routing, and backfill for water, electrical, and fiber. Precision excavation for utility installation with minimal site disruption.

## Key Differentiators

- **20 Years of Experience**: Proven track record since 2004
- **GPS-Guided Precision**: Latest GPS technology for grading accurate to the inch
- **Family-Owned**: Hometown integrity with honest pricing and solid results
- **24/7 Availability**: Direct line to site operations
- **Licensed Contractors**: Excavating, Grading, and Landscape contractor licenses
